allied_standards.note: Standard testing method for determining finished knitted weight and mass per cap in defense textile procurement schedules.

allied_standards.title: Stainless Steel Surgical Instruments - General Requirements
allied_standards.note: Master governing standard for surgical instruments specifying raw material grades (martensitic stainless steel), passivated surface finish, and corrosion resistance.

allied_standards.title: Metallic Materials - Rockwell Hardness Test: Part 1 Test Method
allied_standards.note: Mandatory hardness testing method cited in Clause 6 of IS 3318 for verifying cutting blade hardness (50 to 56 HRC for carbon steel / martensitic stainless steel).

allied_standards.title: Methods of Testing for Corrosion Resistance of Stainless Steel Surgical Instruments
allied_standards.note: Mandatory boiling water and autoclave corrosion test method (copper sulphate test / autoclave test) for surgical cutting instruments.

product: Fuel Injection Nozzles for Diesel Engines (Size 'S')

allied_standards.title: Internal Combustion Engines - Fuel Injection Nozzle Holders - Size 'S'
allied_standards.note: Explicit mating component standard; IS 3170-1 defines the nozzle body engineered specifically to fit into IS 3171 nozzle holders for diesel cylinder heads.

allied_standards.title: Methods of Test for Fuel Injection Nozzles for Diesel Engines
allied_standards.note: Mandatory testing standard for verifying nozzle opening pressure (NOP), spray cone angle, chattering / atomization quality, and back-leakage rate.

allied_standards.title: Hydraulic Fluid Power - Cylinders - Acceptance Tests
allied_standards.note: Mandatory testing code cited in hydraulic cylinder technical specifications for proof pressure testing (1.5x working pressure), internal bypass leakage, and friction breakaway force.

allied_standards.title: Sizes of Cylinder Bores and Piston Rod Diameters for Fluid Power Cylinders
allied_standards.note: Standard series of nominal bore sizes (25 mm to 200 mm) and rod diameters normatively invoked in IS 13103 for compact cylinder sizing.

allied_standards.title: Fluid Power Systems and Components - Cylinder Rod Wiper Rings
allied_standards.note: Companion sealing standard specifying elastomer wiper rings installed in cylinder front gland covers to prevent contaminant ingress on 160 bar hydraulic cylinders.

product: Internal Fuses and Disconnectors for Power Electronic Capacitors

allied_standards.title: Shunt Capacitors for A.C. Power Systems Having a Rated Voltage Above 1000 V - Part 1: General - Performance, Testing and Rating
allied_standards.note: Explicit parent power capacitor standard; IS 13580 Clause 1.1 dictates that it applies to internal fuses designed in conjunction with capacitors complying with IS 13925 / IS 2834.

allied_standards.title: High Voltage Fuses - Part 1: Current-Limiting Fuses
allied_standards.note: Foundational high-voltage fuse safety standard governing prospective breaking current, arc voltage withstand, and coordination for capacitor unit protection.

allied_standards.title: Methods of Sampling and Test for Oils and Fats - Part 1: Sampling, Physical and Chemical Tests
allied_standards.note: Mandatory testing standard cited in Clause 5 & Table 1 of IS 12451 for determining moisture content, fat percentage, melting point of extracted fat, and free fatty acids (FFA).

allied_standards.title: Methods of Sampling and Test for Oils and Fats - Part 2: Purity Tests
allied_standards.note: Mandatory test standard for Baudouin test (to detect sesame oil / vanaspati trace marker), mineral oil detection, and test for synthetic antioxidants in margarine.

allied_standards.title: Methods for Detection of Bacteria Responsible for Food Poisoning - Part 1: Isolation and Identification of Coliform Bacteria
allied_standards.note: Mandatory microbiological safety test method cited in Table 2 of IS 12451 for verifying limits on total plate count, Coliform count, and absence of E. coli and Salmonella.

allied_standards.title: Method for Sieve Analysis of Metal Powders
allied_standards.note: Mandatory testing method cited in Clause 5 of IS 12437 for determination of particle size distribution, fineness, and sieve retention of pyrophoric zirconium metal powder.

allied_standards.title: Guide for Handling and Storage of Explosive and Pyrotechnic Compositions
allied_standards.note: Mandatory statutory explosive safety standard for handling, static dissipation, and explosion hazard mitigation of pyrophoric zirconium metal powders.
